_comment: Mastiff Juggernaut (enemies.md; art-bible.md Sizes: 58x64 on an 80x72 canvas). The .blend is generated by model.py (tools/build.d/60-sprites.sh) into assets/gen/blend/mastiff/. Frames are Blender frame numbers of each action (constant interpolation: one pose per frame). Windup f0 opens the pods, f1 lights the missiles (fb_red).
